Alex H.: Quick heads-up — during vuln triage I found a few RDS snapshots in staging that were created without CMK encryption. Not public, but unencrypted at-rest. Need RBAC + audit plan before we promote any of these snapshots.
DevSecBot: Automated scan: critical_warning: snapshot "staging-db-snap-2026-04-01" encryption=false (rule: rds_snapshot_encrypted). Created by iam:role/nightly-snapshot-lambda.
Maria K.: Can you paste the exact scan output and which snapshots are affected? envs?
Alex H.: paste: ```resource: aws_db_snapshot.staging-db-snap-2026-04-01
account: 123456789012
encryption: false
created_by: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/nightly-snapshot-lambda```
Jonas P.: How did that happen — RDS should default to encryption if the instance was encrypted. Sounds like the lambda copies snapshots without specifying `--kms-key-id`. Nightly lambda code changed in Feb?
Sarah L.: Also, do we know whether EBS/EFS snapshots or S3 backup exports are affected? We should treat all backups as in-scope. What's CloudTrail showing for kms:Decrypt or snapshot-copy events?
Alex H.: Quick inventory: most prod S3 backup buckets use SSE-KMS. A couple internal dev buckets use SSE-S3. EBS snapshots: encrypted except for one dev account. RDS: two staging snapshots unencrypted. I think the lambda lacked `KmsKeyId` in the `CopyDBSnapshot` call.
Maria K.: We need RBAC guardrails: no one should be able to decrypt snapshots except a small set of roles. Proposal: create `snapshot-decryptor` role scoped to `sts:AssumeRole` for ops/lambda only, restrict CMK policy to allow `kms:Decrypt` only from that role and from `kms:ViaService` for rds.amazonaws.com when appropriate.
Jonas P.: Agreed. Also add CloudTrail event logging for `RestoreDBInstanceFromDBSnapshot`, `CopyDBSnapshot`, and `ModifyDBSnapshot` and send to the secure audit bucket. Make those events required for any restore action.
Alex H.: Example CMK policy snippet (draft):
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowSnapshotDecryptForServiceAndRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/snapshot-decryptor"]},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "rds.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
}
```
Maria K.: Please don't grant `kms:Decrypt` to the whole ops group. Use a narrow role and require MFA for assume. Also add `kms:EncryptionContext` checks where possible.
OpsOncall: Heads up — changing CMK policies may break automated restores for Dedicated infra if the snapshot-decryptor role isn't updated simultaneously. We'll need a rollout window and fast rollback plan.
Alex H.: Rollout plan (draft):
1) Create new CMK with restrictive policy and alias `alias/snapshot-key-v2`.
2) Update nightly lambda and any restore automation to reference the alias.
3) Create `snapshot-decryptor` role + restrict assume conditions (MFA + source IP for runbook ops).
4) Enable CloudTrail event selectors & send to secure bucket + SIEM (1y retention by default).
5) Dry-run in staging -> canary prod -> full rollout.
Jonas P.: Additional controls: enforce S3 default encryption (SSE-KMS) at bucket level, block public access, and apply an org SCP preventing writes of unencrypted snapshots/buckets in prod accounts. For cross-account snapshot copies, require `kms:Grant` or use key policy trust.
Sarah L.: For incident triage: mark severity = medium. If attacker could exfil via an unencrypted snapshot, that's higher but no evidence of compromise. Timeline: fix staging within 48h, schedule prod canary within 7 days.
Maria K.: I'll own the RBAC PR and the CMK policy changes. I'll add the CloudTrail selectors in the same ticket. :thumbsup:
DevSecBot: Ticket created: SEC-3221 - "Snapshot encryption + RBAC enforcement" (link: https://tickets.internal/SEC-3221)
OpsOncall: I'll coordinate the rollout window with infra — prefer low-traffic Friday midnight UTC. Ping me when PR ready.
Alex H.: Thanks everyone — I'll open the IAM/CFN PR with the `snapshot-decryptor` role and the CMK policy, and link back here. We'll include a quick rollback (re-alias to old key) and runbook steps for incident response.
Sarah L.: Add to runbook: how to detect unencrypted snapshot creation (CloudTrail filter), step to quarantine snapshot (copy to encrypted key then delete original), and notification steps to security + customer success if production exposed.
Alex H.: Added. Closing loop here — will update SEC-3221 with PR links.
